title: AgentSense: Benchmarking Social Intelligence of Language Agents through Interactive Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing self-assigned goal completion scores against scores given to other agents by the same LLM judge to determine if models overestimate their own performance or exhibit a preference for agents driven by their own model family.

Calculating a Profile Sensitivity Index (PSI) by measuring the standard deviation of goal completion and implicit reasoning metrics across scenarios instantiated with different synthesized agent profiles (varying by age, gender, occupation, and personality traits) to evaluate performance stability.
